description: Approve a MANDATORY governance gate on a deliberation session. When a board session reaches "pending-gate" status, a human must approve the output before it finalizes. This is the human-in-the-loop enforcement mechanism. After approval, the session transitions to "complete" and the full deliberation output becomes available via board_get_session.

gate_id.description: Gate ID from the session status (e.g. "gate-rb-xxx-yyy")

rationale.description: Reason for approval — recorded in the forensic audit chain

name: board_approve_gate
